section.title: Regional pricing
section.afterSave: After you save, the regional pricing panel opens. There you can check the automatic prices and set exact prices for specific countries.

settings.enabledLabel: Charge learners in their own country's price
settings.enabledHelp: We detect each learner's country from their internet connection. Learners in a country you have priced pay that price; everyone else pays this plan's normal price.
settings.currenciesHelp: For each currency you pick, every plan gets a price converted from its normal price at today's exchange rate and rounded to a clean amount (for example ₹999 becomes $11.99). Learners in every country that uses that currency pay it.
settings.currenciesPlaceholder: Search and pick currencies, e.g. US Dollar
settings.noCurrencies: No currency picked yet, so only countries you give a fixed price will see a different price.
settings.ratesNever: Exchange rates have not been fetched yet
settings.gatewayNote: Learners are only charged in a currency your payment gateway accepts. PhonePe and Cashfree take INR only, and eWay takes AUD and NZD. Razorpay needs international payments switched on in your Razorpay account.

plans.explain: Automatic prices follow the exchange rate. You can type over any of them, or add a fixed price for a single country. A country price always wins over the currency price.
plans.offNote: Regional pricing is off, so every learner pays the normal price. The prices below are kept for when you switch it on.
plans.empty: This payment option has no plans.
plans.noCurrencyPrices: None yet. Pick currencies in step 1 to create them.

row.reviewHint: This plan's normal price changed after you set this. Check it still fits.

add.button: Add a price for a specific country
add.title: Fixed price for one country
add.currencyHint: Filled in with the local currency of {{country}}. Change it if you want to charge in another one.
add.auto: Work the price out from the exchange rate instead

delete.title: Remove the price for {{region}}?
delete.description: Learners there will get the price for their currency, or the normal price.

toast.refreshed: Prices updated from today's exchange rates
toast.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
